findings.message: `CAST(datehour AS STRING) >= '2025-06-01'` wraps the partition column `datehour` in CAST(... AS STRING), so BigQuery can't use it to skip partitions of `proj.web.pageviews`. BigQuery rejects queries on this table unless a filter on `datehour` can limit the partitions.
findings.fix: Compare `datehour` itself with a constant, for example `datehour >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)`.
